test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’,

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

Based on the above, how is M related to Q if ‘M ÷ N – O × P + Q’ ?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Daughter
 Husband 
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: M ÷ N – O × P + Q

It means: M is the sister of N, N is the daughter of O, O is the husband of P and P is the mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/656f8bd189c16a1650de117b6ee040dc3ed341a699a54c3e52809a7797688f89.png] 

So, M is the **sister **of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
